references.text: Repeats the command that all men shall appear before the Lord God three times a year, almost word-for-word parallel to this verse.
Summarizes the three annual festivals (unleavened bread, the Feast of Weeks, and the Feast of Tabernacles) where all men must appear before the Lord's presence.
The immediate context describing the three festivals: the Festival of Unleavened Bread, the Harvest Festival, and the Gathering Festival.
Parallel text describing the same three annual festivals in connection with the renewal of the covenant.
Detailed description of the three pilgrimage festivals: Passover/unleavened bread, the Feast of Weeks (shavuot), and the Feast of Tabernacles (sukkot).
Complete calendar of the Lord's feasts, including the three main festivals where Israel was to gather.
This verse gives the divine promise of protection as a prerequisite for fulfilling the requirement in Ex 23:17.
